entries.0df9156aeaa8ae16: A food company that manufactures and sells "breads of the world" such as pizza and naan, and also operates takeout shops selling items such as taiyaki, and restaurants.
entries.47d810369e4626b9: It operates restaurant stores such as 'Harvester Yakumo' in Yakumo Town, Hokkaido. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.626cbe08db9e17bc: This business manufactures and sells pizza and ethnic bread products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,579 million. Manufacturing takes place at the Tama Plant (Inagi City, Tokyo), the Chiba Plant (Narita City, Chiba Prefecture) and the Kyushu Plant (Koga City, Fukuoka Prefecture).
entries.709233a75ae9d260: This is the takeout format for premium grilled skewers and chicken prepared foods, and for the taiyaki shop 'Omedetai Yaki Honpo', operated through company-operated stores and franchises. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.88f8c37e41c4c2bd: This business operates restaurant stores, food retail and delivery. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,041 million. As of March 31, 2026, there were 42 restaurant stores.
entries.92fad6ffbbcb1d0d: Pizza products centered on frozen pizza. These have been the core products since the company's founding, and for household use it also sells premium frozen pizzas 'HOKKAIDO PIZZA' and 'THE PIZZA'. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.e2054912dad1a1be: A range of breads from around the world, including naan, pita bread, focaccia and tortillas, collectively referred to as 'World Breads'. It also sells them to prepared food makers and others that supply supermarkets and convenience stores. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.f559112be30ffbde: General consumers who visit the stores
